X1_holdout_n59.note: Pre-ice run (n=59) reproduces paper numbers exactly, but test products overlapped training fold. On current corpus only 41 products exist and rho drops to 0.280 (p=0.076, not significant).

X3_retrained_holdout_n118.note: Clean retrain on 513 products, evaluated on 118 holdout products. Plausible against oracle ceiling (0.774), though paper p-value (7.6e-7) was understated vs analytic t-test (7.4e-10).

X4_initial_temporal_n66.note: Cannot rebuild n=66 cohort (actual post-cutoff mature count is 51, not 66). On actual mature set (n=51), TRUE review-aspect oracle ceiling is only rho=0.466, AUC=0.810; paper claim (0.545 / 0.901) exceeds the true-aspect ceiling.

X5_extended_temporal_n125.note: From 80/20 quantile split (505 train, 126 test, 125 evaluated). High pooled rho (0.590) is driven by between-category separation; forward skill within categories collapses to mean rho ~0.16 (power banks and ice makers at ~0).

X6_monotonic_ablation.paper_claim: Monotone constraints raised holdout AUC 0.826 -> 0.903 and temporal AUC 0.925 -> 0.942
X6_monotonic_ablation.note: Not reproduced on identical holdout partition. In an apples-to-apples ablation on the holdout, monotone constraints reduced AUC (0.917 -> 0.750). The paper's claim compared the n=90 development set (0.826) against the n=118 deployment cohort (0.903).

X7_price_free_ablation.paper_claim: Price-free ablation rho 0.475 and r=0.147 between its prediction and price percentile
X7_price_free_ablation.note: Not reproduced / conflation: 0.147 is the exact correlation of the within-category price percentile with success on all 631 products (and across holdout splits), not the correlation between the price-free prediction and price.

X8_aspect_fidelity.note: Reproduced. Across 118 paired products, Pearson r of bridged scores against review-extracted features matches paper within ±0.004 for all 9 aspects.

X9_ice_makers_diagnostics.paper_claim: Ice makers: bridged SD 0.08 / 0.13, fidelity r 0.04, holdout rho 0.11; power banks rho 0.43 -> 0
X9_ice_makers_diagnostics.note: Reproduced. Flat commodity specifications yield nearly uniform bridged scores (SD 0.09-0.13), suppressing fidelity (r ~ 0.03-0.08), while power banks collapse from 0.43 random to -0.03 forward in time.

X10_reddit_ab.note: Reproduced. Delta rho = +0.049 (+0.048), 10,000 paired bootstrap 95% CI [-0.024, 0.127] spans zero, confirming the Reddit lift is not statistically significant.
